findings.resolution: All specialist consumer paths retain typed original A3/A4 replay inputs and directly rerun their deterministic validators. Caller callbacks and importable seal objects were removed.

Identifiers, prompts and captured output reject common API, GitHub, Slack, AWS, PEM, JWT, credential-URL, frontdoor and Salesforce session-token patterns. Only stable allowlisted provider and gap codes persist; raw exceptions do not.

Documents, child proposals and artifacts are strict ANALYSIS_ONLY, CANDIDATE and INFERRED types with all authority and release-evidence flags false. No EvidenceRef, approval, tool execution or release-decision field is accepted.

Repository policy, evaluation, prompt schema and ontology paths/digests are internally pinned and non-overridable at the public consumer boundary. Provider profiles and captured outcomes have full independent digests.

Relation proposals are checked against the pinned ontology endpoint signature and the cited path's ordered source, target and canonical relation. Candidate propositions bind candidate, entity, evidence and assertion digest.

Any unresolved fusion conflict forces document-level abstention, zero accepted proposals, a sanitized conclusion and a blocking UNRESOLVED_FUSION_CONFLICT gap; narrative winner selection cannot survive.

The injected port owns the provider profile; host-measured timing replaces provider claims, token and response budgets are enforced, failure classifications are consistent and a full captured-outcome digest prevents paired receipt substitution.
